description.value: Vogue Hotel is a downtown Vancouver hotel located on Granville Street, one of the city's main commercial corridors. The hotel's own website highlights the Granville Street area with a walking tour video, suggesting its appeal is largely tied to its central urban location. For a touring cyclist, the Granville Street position places it within walking distance of the dense restaurant, grocery, and entertainment options of Vancouver's downtown core.

The hotel appears real and open based on the active website with contact information.

OSM record contains no address or phone; values taken from website only, so contact_confirmed for phone and address cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
